Subject: Redwood MSA + Order Form — kickoff and timeline

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the intro — excited to get started. We're ready to move forward with Redwood and need to get an MSA + Order Form in place to satisfy our procurement timelines. Attached are two items to help: a short list of questions from our legal team and a signer matrix.

Key asks from our side:
- Confirm Redwood's standard data residency language and whether we can specify US-only storage for PHI-adjacent data.
- Any required SOC2 evidence or compliance portal links we can share with procurement.
- Standard invoice/billing cadence and a PO acceptance process (we can send a PO once the Order Form is signed).

Attachments: Caraway_MSA_questions.pdf (PDF), Caraway_Signer_List.xlsx (XLSX)

Can we target internal approval + countersign by the end of next week (Aug 27)? Would appreciate a quick kickoff call — we're available Aug 19 afternoon or Aug 20 morning.

Thanks,
Maria Garcia
Director, Procurement
Caraway Labs

Subject: Re: Redwood MSA + Order Form — kickoff and timeline

Hi Maria — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for the materials. I’ve looped in Kimberly (legal) and Marissa (commercial onboarding) so we can map next steps.

A few quick clarifications so we can scope the redline work efficiently:
- Please confirm the exact legal entity name and address for Exhibit A (as it should appear on the MSA).
- Billing contact and PO flow (email + any internal PO number format) — Marissa will take lead on invoicing details.
- Data residency: we can support US-only storage via a scoped Exhibit C; Kimberly, can you confirm the template language we typically use?
- Security evidence: if you can share the SOC2 request, Mina (security) will validate what we can provide and whether we need a one-off attestation.

Proposed timeline from our side:
1) Redwood marked draft (initial redline) — by EOD 2026-08-21
2) Internal legal review and finalization — 2026-08-22 to 2026-08-24
3) Send to Caraway for counterparty review — target 2026-08-25

We can do a 30-minute kickoff today at 3:30pm PT or tomorrow at 10:00am PT — please confirm which works.

Attachments referenced: Redwood_MSA_Template_v3.docx (we will start from this).

Best,
Soojin Lee
Director, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-08-19T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood MSA + Order Form — kickoff and timeline

Thanks, Soojin. Quick note on approach so the external team knows what to expect:

1) Scope and baseline: we'll start from Redwood_MSA_Template_v3.docx and produce a single marked-up draft highlighting our standard vs. requested changes.

2) Priority items to surface early (per procurement signal + typical carrier asks):
   - Data residency / data processing exhibit (Exhibit C): if Caraway requires US-only residency for regulated data, we'll include the scoped language but note that any cross-border subprocessing will require an amendment.
   - Liability and indemnity: we'll propose a commercial cap (typically 3x ARR or $XM); if they have a vendor-specific cap, ask them to state it explicitly.
   - Audit / security access: we will provide SOC2 report overview and a standard evidence package; on-site audits are negotiated case-by-case.

3) Deliverables and timeline: marked draft by EOD 8/21; clean redline + table-of-changes by 8/24. Marissa, please prepare invoicing contact info and sample PO acceptance wording so we can insert into the Order Form.

4) Routing: Jonas, please triage any legal exceptions that require exec sign-off. Mina, please review the SOC2 ask once we receive Caraway's questionnaire.

I'll attach the template and an internal redline checklist to keep versioning predictable.

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_Template_v3.docx (DOCX), Redline_Checklist.pdf (PDF)

-KP
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
